title: Effect of Insoles in Patients With Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
brief_summary: Demonstrate that custom-made insoles improve painful symptomatology, health and foot function in subjects with SLE and podiatric involvement.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years or more.
* Medical diagnosis of LES.
* Foot involvement.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Treatment with foot orthoses.
* LES with acute symptomatic flare.
* Ulcers.
* Skin involvement.
* Neurological problems.
* Cognitive deterioration.
* Need for walking assistance.
* Refused to change footwear to use the foot orthoses.
